GuardrailDecision.title: GuardrailDecision
GuardrailDecision.description: Immutable-after-decision log record of a human operator approving or dismissing a deterministic guardrail recommendation for a Delta instrument.

uid.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching request.auth.uid.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the decision document was created.

regime.description: Phase 2 market regime label at evaluation time.

inputValues.description: Exact regime metric inputs observed when the rule fired.

rulesFired.description: List of user-defined guardrail rules that fired.

thresholds.description: Exact threshold comparisons evaluated for each fired rule.

decision.description: Human operator decision (or null if pending before single decision update).

decidedAt.description: Server timestamp when the operator approved or dismissed the alert.

candleTimestamp.description: ISO timestamp of the latest candle used in the regime evaluation.

explanation.description: Optional Phase 4 Gemini explanation snapshot (text, model, generatedAt, recordedAt, status, summary, whyItFired, limitations) written once at decision time or appended once after generation.

/users/{userId}/decisions/{decisionId}.description: Private user-scoped guardrail decision audit log. Only the owning authenticated user can read and create records, with at most one write setting decision/decidedAt if initially pending, and no deletes.
